v: VERY GOOD ki GREAT ki madhyalo ekkado 🙏 Raw ga, honest ga untundi. Class topper kaani vallaki ee marks/job/settle pressure chaala familiar ga hit avvachu.
e: Needi Naadi Oke Katha stays admirably raw and focused instead of adding commercial distractions. That same honesty may limit its reach with viewers looking only for easy entertainment, but average and below-average students can connect instantly with its pressures, its idea of what it means to ‘settle’ in life and Sree Vishnu’s wonderfully natural performance.
body:
the film gets struck some where between a Very Good Movie and a Great Movie!!!! Kudos to the director for keeping the movie raw and to the point without adding any commercial elements, however that is what it makes the movie not connected to normal audience who watch movie for time pass!!!

Story wise its apt and any average and below average student gets connected to the movie instantly!!! and that dialogue Settle avadam ante okkapudu Govt job vasthey life lo settle avadam ane valu…tarvatha Bank Job ipudemooo Software Job!!!! _/\_

Sri Vishnu……such a natural performer _/\_ will ensure not to miss his movies

v: Hmmm... totally disconnected 😄 Visuals bagunnayi, Varun + Raashii mature ga act chesaru... but ee love-at-first-sight + ego-love story naaku malli work avvaledu.
e: Tholiprema may have worked for almost everyone around me, including my friends and parents, but I remained completely disconnected from its romance. I liked several dialogues, the cinematography and the mature work from Varun Tej and Raashii Khanna; unfortunately the contrived romantic setup and familiar hero-heroine ego conflict overwhelmed those positives for me.
body:
hmmmm…..felt totally disconnected!!!! Need to find the reason why I dont like watching Love stories….still Thinking what was the last total love story i liked? (may be Love Aaj Kal? or cocktail? or Anand? or Godavari?)

Not sure when our film makers start making REALISTIC love stories rather than coming up with nonsense like love at first sight and giving the actress no other option rather than fallingnfor him jst bcoz the hero fights for her and blend them wiyh no sense scenes!!! Who the hell now a days get out of train to fetch drinking water from Tap _/\_ and more over Hero Heorine madhya ego problems Kushi nunchi chusthundhe

Having said that when all my friends liked the movie including my parents…..the only thing I can say is thanks to RGV for fucking up my taste for Love stories!!!

PS : when the whole Telugu states were gaga over Yem Maya Chesave…..probably I was the only one who hated it 😦

However Loved couple of dialogues “Devudike caste lenaapudu….afterall manushulam manaki caste endhuku uncle” “Manushulam….prema gurthundadhu thappulu okate gurthuntayi” “mqnatho kondaru prema natistharu, kondaru kopam natisthaaru…kaani mana medha kopam natichevaalle ekuva premistharu”…..Cinematography and visuals were excellent….Varun Tej and Rasi gave matured performances

v: AWEsomely awful aa... AW(E)fully awesome aa? 😄 Decide cheskondi. Naaku మాత్రం every few mins something interesting undi, Regina + BGM especially stood out.
e: AWE! is the kind of unusual film that can divide viewers completely, yet its ambition kept surprising me throughout. Regina Cassandra delivers the standout performance, the BGM is terrific, the humour often carries a thoughtful edge and even the lone song neatly reflects the film’s central conflict.
body:
after watching the movie you may feel AWEsomely AW(E)ful OR AW(E)fully AWEsome……..but for eqch and every 5, 10 mins you will defintely feel AWE!!! BGM has been terrifically AWEsome!!!!

Though there are many performers, you will defintely fell AWE for Regina’s terrific performance!!!

Dialogues are humorus and thought provoking esp between Nani, Priyadarshi and Ravi Teja!!! and couple of dialogues from Nitya Menon as well

Though there is only one song, the lyrics is too good!!! SHATRUVAY DEHAME…..MANASUTHO THALAPADE!!!! sums up the story line _/\_

v: Intha controversy, intha grandeur... naaku మాత్రం story very thin ga anipinchindi 😐 Ranveer super, climax/jauhar portions Bhansali magic... migatha chala flat.
e: Padmaavat left me wondering what inspired Sanjay Leela Bhansali to fight so hard to make this particular story. The film is visually grand in places and Ranveer Singh is terrific, while Ratan Singh’s death and the jauhar sequence show Bhansali at his strongest; unfortunately Shahid Kapoor and Deepika Padukone feel badly underused and the core story never held me.
body:
wonder what has inspired mr.Bhansali to take up this project against all odds!!!! a nothing story of Two already married men’s lust for a women!!! Except for few low light grand shots and terrific performance from Ranveer the movie has nothing in it

Shahid Kapoor has a impeccable acting talent is unfortunately reduced to a single expression extra artist and Deepika who did fabulous acting even in crab Happy New Year is reduced to No expression artist

The shot in which Ratan Singh dies while fighting Khilji & the whole Jauhar episode shows the brilliance of Bhansali _/\_
